title: Network-requested PDU session release procedure initiation

entities.name: Network-requested PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network (SMF) to release a PDU session. The SMF creates and sends a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message to the UE with appropriate cause values and information elements.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by SMF to UE to initiate PDU session release. Contains various IEs including 5GSM cause, PTI, Access type, Back-off timer value, and Service-level-AA container.

entities.name: 5GSM cause
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for PDU session release. Contains specific cause values like #8, #26, #29, #39, #46, #67, #69.

entities.name: PTI
entities.description: Procedure Transaction Identity IE used to correlate messages between UE and network during PDU session procedures.

entities.name: Access type
entities.description: Information element indicating the access type (3GPP access) for the PDU session.

entities.name: Back-off timer value
entities.description: Timer value IE that may be included with certain 5GSM cause values to control UE behavior after session release.

entities.name: Service-level-AA container
entities.description: Container for service-level authentication and authorization responses, including SLAR and C2AR fields.

entities.name: T3592
entities.description: Timer started by SMF when sending PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message. Stopped upon receipt of PDU SESSION RELEASE COMPLETE.

entities.name: UE out of LADN service area
entities.description: Condition where UE is outside LADN service area, triggering PDU session release with cause #46.

entities.name: High priority access UE
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for high priority access or emergency services, affecting Back-off timer inclusion.

entities.name: UE removed from MBS sessions
entities.description: Behavior where SMF considers UE removed from associated MBS sessions when PDU session is released under certain conditions.

relations.description: The procedure involves sending the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message
The message contains the 5GSM cause IE indicating release reason
The message contains PTI IE for procedure correlation
The message may contain Access type IE
The message may contain Back-off timer value IE for certain cause values
The message may contain Service-level-AA container for UAS services
The procedure starts timer T3592 when sending release command
UE being out of LADN service area requires cause #46 in 5GSM cause IE
High priority access UE condition prevents inclusion of Back-off timer value IE
UE out of LADN with specific access conditions leads to removal from MBS sessions
